claims: Suzanne Collins authored The Hunger Games franchise.
The Hunger Games features a televised battle royale where teenagers fight to the death.
The battle royale maintains Capitol control over 12 districts.
Katniss Everdeen volunteers for the 74th Hunger Games to save her sister.
Katniss Everdeen volunteering sparks a rebellion.
The Hunger Games is set in the nation of Panem.
Panem was formerly North America.
The Capitol forces each district to provide one boy and one girl as tributes for the annual Games.
Katniss Everdeen is portrayed by Jennifer Lawrence.
Peeta Mellark is portrayed by Josh Hutcherson.
Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark represent District 12 in the 74th Hunger Games.
Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark overcome trained Career tributes.
Katniss Everdeen is the protagonist.
Katniss Everdeen is known as The Girl on Fire.
Katniss Everdeen is a skilled archer from District 12.
Peeta Mellark is the male tribute from District 12.
Peeta Mellark is a baker's son.
Haymitch Abernathy is a former victor.
Haymitch Abernathy mentors Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark.
President Snow is the leader of Panem.
The Hunger Games films are produced by Color Force (Nina Jacobson, Jon Kilik).
The Hunger Games films are distributed by Lionsgate.
Gary Ross directed the first Hunger Games film.
Francis Lawrence directed the subsequent Hunger Games movies.
The Hunger Games film franchise has grossed over $3.4 billion worldwide.
The first Hunger Games film was released in 2012.
The Hunger Games franchise has sold over 100 million copies of the books worldwide.
Sunrise on the Reaping is scheduled for theatrical release on November 20, 2026.
The Hunger Games (2012) launched a five-film series.
